Yes, the protestor may be prosecuted. Dumping the trash is expressive conduct, but under *O'Brien* and *Texas v. Johnson* a content-neutral, generally applicable littering ordinance serves a substantial interest in park cleanliness unrelated to suppressing the message, so it is valid as applied. The incidental burden on speech is no greater than necessary, since he could have conveyed the message without leaving trash behind.

CONFIDENCE: 88
